violated_contract: An attributed outcome must identify a result permitted by its source relationship and outcome code. Checking only that an account owns the attribution chain allows an unrelated same-owner task or artifact to be counted as that recommendation outcome. The pre-0187 Cloudflare outcome handler performed only the chain-existence query and omitted the original upstream relationship policy.
canonical_prevention: Project the original outcome relationship policy through the ordinary Worker builder. Read its canonical Candidate/task/artifact dependencies and chain source through the transaction owner, recheck those exact snapshots and live generation with the outcome receipt in one D1 batch, and test unrelated subjects, kind/code mismatches, changed relationships, original retries and rollback through public HTTP. The local incident and source comparison are recorded in dev/unified-main/implementation-2026-09-05/canonical-outcomes-2026-09-08.md.
